notes.title: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2 - Producer Letter – Dec. 20th, 2019
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210626/2b1141e8b1d5badfa47caa99a759c648717f87ac.jpg[/img]

[h1]Notice: The below patch was released on December 23, 2019[/h1]

To all the players who have been playing DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2.

Hello everyone, I am the producer of this game, Shiraishi.
Thank you very much for playing DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2!

I have been looking at your comments, feedback, not to mention your great builds that have been posted on the Steam community hub since the launch of the JUMBO DEMO.
The development team has taken on board your feedback and will publish a patch in the coming days which includes the following four fixes:

[b]1. Fixing the issues pertaining to highly sensitive mice[/b]
If you are using a gaming mouse, depending on the Report Rate (Polling Rate) setting, there are instances when the camera movement speed drops significantly when controlling with a mouse. We have prepared a setting option in the config tool for players using a gaming mouse. 

[b]2. Individually control initial automatic graphic settings[/b]
We had prepared an automatic adjustment function that analyses the player's PC specifications and optimizes the graphic setting, only when the game is initially launched. That said, if a player adjusted the graphic quality manually in the config tool prior to launching the game, the game's automatic adjustment function would read just the setting during the initial start-up.
Therefore, we will adjust this function, so the graphic setting is not automatically adjusted, only in cases where the setting has been manually changed. *This function only kicks in when the game is launched for the first time, so there is no impact on those who have already been playing the game. 

[b]3. Fixing the issue pertaining to certain detection not functioning normally due to an increase in FPS[/b]
Depending on the environment, there are instances when the game exceeds 60FPS; such cases could lead to certain detections not functioning normally, leading to cases where it obstructs game progression, so this issue will be fixed. (For example, in the tutorial, when the captain enters the hold of the ship, the player is obstructed from progressing further.)

[b]4. Fixing the issue where NPCs cannot jump[/b]
We are fixing the issue where NPCs would not be able to jump if you assign “cross”, “Start”, or “back” button or clear the assign for the “jump” movement in the pad operation.

We hope you carry on enjoying the game!
DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2 Producer - Takuma Shiraishi
